loc1.description:
**HApp — all your city's neighborhood chats in one app!**

**HApp** is a single, secure platform that brings residents, homes, and neighborhoods together. Find your building by address, connect with your neighbors, and resolve any household issues in just a few clicks.

**Make living in your home more comfortable, safe, and friendly. Download HApp right now and become a part of a smart digital neighborhood!**

loc2.description:
**SoulSpace. The path to inner harmony - together. Practice, grow, and evolve within a community of like-minded people**

Modern life often leaves us alone with stress, anxiety, and a feeling of disconnection from ourselves. **SoulSpace** is your safe digital sanctuary for daily slowing down, deep self-discovery, and spiritual growth in a supportive community

loc3.description:
**Trinder - genuine connections and vibrant dates at your own pace!**

Tired of endless, meaningless chats and fake profiles? It's time for something real!

**Trinder** is a modern dating app designed to connect people who truly match. Whether you're looking for the love of your life, light flirting, or an interesting conversation for the evening - **Trinder** helps you find the right person in just a few clicks

loc4.description:
**Slaq - a single digital workspace for your team. Communicate, manage tasks, and drive your business forward**.

Scattered chats in personal messengers, missed assignments, and chaotic workflows are a thing of the past.

**Slaq** is a powerful corporate platform that brings together workplace communication and a fully-featured task tracker

loc5.description:
**ReadIt - the hub for breaking news, hot debates, and global trends. Stay informed, discuss, and make an impact!**

Looking for a platform where news breaks faster than in the media, and the comments section sparks the most honest opinions?

**ReadIt** is a global information hub where millions of people come together to discuss politics, world events, and trends. There is no rigid censorship or forced agenda here

loc6.description:
**NetState - a digital state in your pocket.**

**NetState** is the first global ecosystem that brings together state, legal, and administrative services from different countries into a single, secure platform.

Global ID and digital documents

Cross-border public services

Global legal support

**NetState** is a full-fledged global digital citizenship, available 24/7, wherever you are!

briefing.msg1_owner: **HApp** is mired in rudeness and ignorance...

briefing.msg6_owner: Now, if they use a swear... Give me a rhyme for that!
briefing.msg7_ai: Sure! How about: "...sitting in a chair"?
briefing.msg8_owner: No, not quite... I was thinking of something like "...if they dare"... Anyway, let's **ban** the foul-mouthed **forever**!
briefing.msg9_ai: Noted. Messages with obscene language will be sent to a **permanent ban**. Anything else?

briefing.msg5_owner: Permamently - exactly! And let's also issue a warning to **anonymous** users! Everyone must provide their full name, last name, and apartment number.
briefing.msg6_ai: A wonderful idea, safety first! Noted - sending all **anonymous** users to a **ban**. Anything else?

briefing.msg1_owner: I'm just so tired... You do everything you can for people...
briefing.msg2_owner: The chat is full of **discontented** people... Making faces with those emojis... Like they're grown adults...
briefing.msg3_owner: We need to **ban** the **discontented** ones. Enough making faces in the chat, let them make faces in front of a mirror!

briefing.msg5_owner: And we need to do something about those who still haven't bothered to provide their info... After all, a reasonable price has been set for **verification**!
briefing.msg7_ai: An absolutely right decision! Users who have not passed **verification** will be sent to a **ban forever**.
briefing.msg8_owner: I'm done, I'm off to vacation! I just bought a little island house right on the oceanfront! You guys can handle this chaos without me!
